action: “You went somewhere.” Low, just for him; his other palm is still flat on the case and the room comes back together around it. “That wasn't a tired thing.” “It was a tired thing.” “JC.” “It was a tired thing, Manny.” He wipes the milk: his skin is pink and fine. He dumps the latte and starts another, 'performing steady'. “I didn't eat. I told my mom I'd eaten. I didn't eat.” Manny takes his hand off slowly, watches from the side of his eye.
